procedure cancel_pick_slips is
--
 -- temp_pick VARCHAR2(10); -- SCR 18714
 temp_pick VARCHAR2(13);
 cursor c1 is
 select pick_slip_id from pick_slips
 where chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and order_no = :orders.order_no
 and pick_slip_type = :allocated
 and pick_slip_status in (:open, :unfilled);

 from pick_slip_products
 where chapter_id = :g_chapter_id

 --

 set_stock_state(:available, c2rec.unit_id, c2rec.coll_date,
 c2rec.product_code, c2rec.aliquot);
 end loop;
 begin
 update pick_slips
 set pick_slip_status = :canceled
 where chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and pick_slip_id = c1rec.pick_slip_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS

 --

 product_type, exp_date, blood_type, box_id, product_status
 from pick_slip_products psp
 where chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and item_no = :items.item_no

 (select 'x' from pick_slips
 where chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and order_no = :orders.order_no

 c1rec.coll_date, c1rec.product_code, c1rec.aliquot);

 c1rec.product_type, c1rec.box_id, :restk_pend );
 --
 set_stock_state(:restk_pend, c1rec.unit_id, c1rec.coll_date,
 c1rec.product_code, c1rec.aliquot);
 end if;
 end loop;
end;

procedure reset_order_status is
 temp_number number;
 status_number number := 9;
 temp_status VARCHAR2(2);
 temp_rec_no VARCHAR2(5);
 temp_block VARCHAR2(40);
begin
 temp_rec_no := :system.cursor_record;

 --

 3, :back_ordered, 4, :packed,

 7, :closed, 9, :canceled, 8, 'SY' )

 from dual;
 --
 if :orders.order_status != :back_ordered
 or temp_status not in (:ordered, :allocated)
 then
 :orders.order_status := temp_status;

ProgramUnit.Name: RESET_ITEM_STATUS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure reset_item_status is
 temp_no number;
 min_no number;
 temp_status VARCHAR2(2);
begin
 if :items.required_qty = nvl(:items.canceled_qty,0)
 then
 temp_status := 'CA';
 elsif :items.allocated_qty < :items.required_qty
 - nvl(:items.canceled_qty,0)
 then
 if :items.allocated_qty > 0
 then
 temp_status := 'BO';
 else
 temp_status := 'OR';
 end if;
 else
 --
 -- find the earliest status for this item
 select min(decode(product_status, :allocated, 1, :packed, 2,
 :shipped, 3, :delivered, 4, 5))
 into temp_no
 from pick_slip_products psp, pick_slips ps
 where psp.chapter_id = :Global.chapter_id
 and ps.chapter_id = :Global.chapter_id
 and ps.pick_slip_id = psp.pick_slip_id
 and ps.order_no = :orders.order_no
 and psp.item_no = :items.item_no;
 --
 -- convert back to proper status
 select decode(temp_no, 1, :allocated, 2, :packed,
 3, :shipped, 4, :closed, 'CA' )
 into temp_status
 from dual;
 end if;
 :item_status := temp_status;
end;

procedure parse_abo_local (scan_abo in VARCHAR2,

 SELECT decode(sign(sysdate - nvl(isbt_start_date,sysdate+1)),

 or (
 (upper(abo_desc) like upper(temp_entry||'%')

 and temp_v_code_scheme = 'I')
 )

 AND rownum < 2 --tmpp
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 -- if found it, return
 return;
 exception

 null;
 when OTHERS then

 -- last try, match a free style entry (e.g. 'a-')

 temp_entry := replace(temp_entry,' ','');
 -- message('temp='||temp_entry||' '||pl_abo_desc);pause;

 and (upper (abo_desc) like upper(pl_abo_desc) || '%' or upper(pl_abo_desc) like upper(abo_desc)||'%')

EXCEPTION
